# Set up Copilot CLI roles

Use [Copilot dispatch](../../helix/references/copilot.md) to check the installed
CLI and current custom-agent schema. Read the native model picker and its effort
choices; the discovery script in this bundle covers Codex and Claude only.

Show existing role settings and ask only for missing model, effort and scope
choices. Prefer a task-scoped CLI selection for a one-off request. For persistent
setup, use Copilot's supported project or user custom-agent files. Explain any
broader effect and preview the exact change before saving.

A reviewer needs suitable read tools, scoped paths, required model selection
where supported, and repository instructions. Custom subagents require explicit
instruction inclusion or a complete brief. Preserve unrelated configuration.

Read back saved settings and validate them through Copilot's own discovery.
Configuration is not execution proof; report a live dispatch separately. If the
CLI or requested model is unavailable, leave settings unchanged and explain it.
